## Notes
The HOBEIAN ZG-107Z is a  TOF ranging sensor. It measures the distance to the water surface and reports the water level in centimeters and percent. Configuration values (e.g., tank depth or installation height) are set in millimeters.
<!-- Notes END: Do not edit below this line -->



## Options
*[How to use device type specific configuration](../guide/configuration/devices-groups.md#specific-device-options)*

* `time_start`: Reply to Tuya-specific time synchronization requests: "1970" - Reply with seconds since 1970/01/01 (recommended, should stop the device from asking), "2000" - Reply with seconds since 2000/01/01 (use if the weekday is wrong with 1970), "off" - Don't reply (use if replying causes too much traffic). Default for this device: "off". The value must be one of `1970`, `2000`, `off`


## Exposes

### fill state (enum)
fill_state.
Value can be found in the published state on the `liquid_state` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The possible values are: `low`, `normal`, `high`.

### fill percent (numeric)
fill ratio.
Value can be found in the published state on the `liquid_level_percent` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### fiil depth (numeric)
fiil depth.
Value can be found in the published state on the `liquid_depth` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The unit of this value is `m`.
Fill depth= Max Fill Depth -TOF Distance +(Installation height - Max Fill Depth).

### tof distance (numeric)
tof distance.
Value can be found in the published state on the `tof_distance` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The unit of this value is `m`.
Actual measured distance value,Calibratable by configuration(distance_calibration).



### distance calibration (numeric)
distance calibration.
Value can be found in the published state on the `distance_calibration` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) or write (`/set`) this value.
The unit of this value is `m`.

### Min set (numeric)
Liquid minimum percentage.
Value can be found in the published state on the `min_set` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"min_set": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### Max set (numeric)
Liquid maximum percentage.
Value can be found in the published state on the `max_set` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"max_set": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `0` and the maximum value is `100`.
The unit of this value is `%`.

### Fill depth max (numeric)
Distance from sensor to liquid surface.
Value can be found in the published state on the `liquid_depth_max` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"liquid_depth_max": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `0.1` and the maximum value is `2`.
The unit of this value is `m`.

### Installation height (numeric)
Distance from sensor to bottom of the tank.
Value can be found in the published state on the `installation_height` property.
It's not possible to read (`/get`) this value.
To write (`/set`) a value publish a message to topic `zigbee2mqtt/FRIENDLY_NAME/set` with payload `{"installation_height": VALUE}`.
The minimal value is `0.1` and the maximum value is `3`.
The unit of this value is `m`.


### distance measurement (enum)
distance measurement.
Value can be found in the published state on the `distance_measurement` property.
It's not possible to write (`/set`) this value.
Actively test distance information; online mode needs to be enabled.
